references.text: The basis of the firstborn law: every firstborn belongs to the Lord and must be consecrated to him.
Firstborn of cattle and sheep are to be given to the Lord, but a donkey may be redeemed with a lamb.
Firstborn of cattle and sheep are to be given to the Lord on the eighth day.
The blood is to be sprinkled on the altar, and the fat burned as a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.
The fat is to be burned on the altar as a fire offering, a pleasing aroma to the Lord.
The blood is to be sprinkled around the altar, and the fat burned as a fire offering, a fragrant aroma to the Lord.
Firstborn of livestock already belong to the Lord and cannot be consecrated as a special gift.
Firstborn of cattle and sheep are to be brought to the place the Lord chooses.
All firstborn males of cattle and sheep must be consecrated to the Lord.
